lines: Blessings stretch eastward like the boundless sea
Long life stands firm as southern mountains rise
A noble friend walks close and shares your way
Heaven's own guardian keeps you under kindly skies
A moon-bright mirror joins two hearts in light
Harmonious strings make every feeling sing
Love, trade, and learning flourish side by side
One fortunate step may win the scholar's crown and ring
A dream comes to the mute, yet finds no voice
A blind hand threads a needle, but cannot see
Nine winding turns leave the bright pearl out of reach
When the road clears, patience will set the spirit free
A white tiger descends the ridge to prey
And finds a hunter's net across its way
The wound one gives returns to strike one's own hand
Leave malice be, and walk with care across the land
Snow-veiled plum trees breathe their fragrance through the gray
A lone fisher casts beneath the quiet starry sky
The hook comes back bare; the boat comes home unladen
Yet moonlit waters bless the empty boat's way
The granaries rise higher than they did last year
A song of peace drifts through each village door
Share the harvest while the kindly heavens shine
A grateful heart is richer than a store of more
A spirited carp still dreams beneath the pond
Though shallow waters hold its power in thrall
When wind and cloud converge, its brow breaks through
And scales become a dragon's as it rises tall
A violet star descends and clears the night
Old wrongs fall back before its steadfast flame
With loyal hands to shelter a troubled realm
A fallen house may rise to honor once again
An iron ship meets storm winds at the gate
A careless vow cannot undo the net
When fortune turns, do not invite the night
Choose a safer harbor while you still have sight
The pilgrim westward takes a rugged way
A steadfast guide appears when cliffs grow steep
Clouds veil the home beyond the mountain pass
Trust those who help your faltering courage keep
Eight immortals cross the sea to feast in the sky
A treasured gift sparks pride, and tempers flare
Let mercy step between the blades and angry cries
One gentle word can mend the quarrel there
Two hearts plan a bridge from banks apart
Yet careful knots come loose before they meet
When spring returns, the scattered boards may join
What fate has marked for you will find your street
The ancient trigrams order earth and sky
No shuttered room can hide a crooked deed
Lift up your head; let honest conduct speak
One upright step can open every gate you need
An arrow shot at moonlight flies in vain
Rotten timber will not bear a throne
An upright heart outshines a thousand rites
Good deeds do more than incense ever can alone
The mantis stalks the cicada on the leaf
Unseen, the yellow sparrow waits above
Do not mistake a smiling face for an honest heart
Keep one wise step between a bargain and your freedom's gate
Two star-born lovers face the Silver River's span
A single meeting cannot redeem the years
Riches fade like dreams before the waking dawn
Hold fast to what is true when glitter disappears
Thunder and lightning shake the roof of night
A house that sows good deeds will harvest cheer
A house that sows harm will reap its thorns
Choose the kindly hand that makes tomorrow clear
The wind lies still; the harbor opens wide
Full cups and hearty laughter warm the day
Old friends and learned guests exchange their tales
While fortunate tides carry every boat away
The eastern sun breaks through the drifting cloud
Clear light lays its colors on the plain
Meet every season with a ready hand
And fourfold spring will bless the year again
A single lamp burns steady by the door
A gracious hand adds oil and makes it bright
Where danger hides, its glow reveals the way
Hold up that little flame, and fear will fade from sight
By the Wei River, an old fisherman bides his time
A wise alliance turns a troubled age to peace
When people live secure, the world is open wide
Let patient service make the realm's good fortune increase
A hand seeks silver while a hidden thief draws near
The barred gate may be the wisest choice tonight
Stay within your home; let distant glitter go
Guarded peace will keep its own warm light aglow
A little fish flounders on the shallow bar
Beyond the bend, deep waters wait below
Keep faith with your own heart; do not sell it short
The high, clear mountain is your truest friend
A prisoner leaves the gate and finds a feast
A few warm cups release the heart from grief
Hold back your anger for a single breath
Not every passing slight deserves a fight
Three different names unite with one accord
Their brotherly bond makes iron yield at last
A jewel from Kunshan gleams beneath their care
When trust joins courage, base metal turns to gold
A sacred cradle waits beneath the household eaves
An old prayer shines like jade through midnight's veil
When new life comes, let wonder fill the rooms
A tender beginning may make the whole house bloom
The leaf may fall; the root remains below
A withered tree blooms when spring rains return
Though roads rise and dip through change and doubt
What truly belongs to you will find its way back home
A quiet faith protects one lantern in the wind
It needs no trumpet—only room to grow
Let trust become the kindness in your hands
Its light will lead beyond what doubters know
